children: UK technology services provider's H1 revenue rose 71.6% yr/yr, led by North America demand
Adjusted pretax profit and adjusted EPS nearly doubled from a year ago
Computacenter expects full-year 2026 adjusted PBT to be no less than £380m
Company cites record product order backlog and strong digital infrastructure demand as outlook drivers
Computacenter expects 2026 capex of £70-75m and adjusted effective tax rate of 28.5%-30.5%

NORTH AMERICA GROWTH - Record performance in North America, with operating profit more than doubling, driven by demand for AI-related infrastructure and growth with hyperscale, neocloud and enterprise customers
TECHNOLOGY SOURCING DEMAND - Substantial growth in Technology Sourcing revenue, especially for AI and data center infrastructure, led by North America and the UK
PROFESSIONAL SERVICES EXPANSION - Strong organic growth in Professional Services, supported by the AgreeYa acquisition in North America
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 9 "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the it services & consulting peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Computacenter PLC is GBp5,250.00, about 6.2% below its September 7 closing price of GBp5,600.00
The stock recently traded at 24 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 22 three months ago
Sept 5 - India's TCS unit to invest up to $7.4 billion in AI data center campus
